package vt // import "ubunatic.com/loom/vt"

Package vt provides a virtual terminal emulator for ANSI screen capture and
testing.

TYPES

type Cell struct {
	Rune  rune
	Text  string // complete grapheme cluster; empty for ordinary single-rune cells
	Style Style
}
    Cell represents a single terminal cell containing a rune and its visual
    style. Wide characters occupy two consecutive cells: the left cell stores
    the rune, while the right cell stores Rune=0 with the same Style.

func (c Cell) String() string

type Color struct {
	Type    ColorType
	Index   uint8
	R, G, B uint8
}
    Color represents a terminal foreground or background color: default,
    256-color palette index (0-255), or 24-bit truecolor RGB.

func ColorIndex(n uint8) Color
    ColorIndex returns a 256-color palette entry (0-15 standard/bright ANSI,
    16-255 xterm).

func ColorRGB(r, g, b uint8) Color
    ColorRGB returns a 24-bit truecolor RGB value.

func ColorReset() Color
    ColorReset returns the default terminal color.

func (c Color) RGB() (r, g, b uint8, ok bool)
    RGB returns the approximate 24-bit RGB value for c and whether one could be
    resolved. ColorDefault returns ok=false. Indexed colors are resolved using
    the standard xterm 256 palette.

func (c Color) String() string

type ColorType uint8
    ColorType specifies the color encoding mode.

const (
	ColorDefault ColorType = iota
	ColorIndexed
	ColorDirect
)
type Style struct {
	FG        Color
	BG        Color
	Bold      bool
	Dim       bool
	Italic    bool
	Underline bool
	Blink     bool
	Reverse   bool
	Hidden    bool
	Strike    bool
}
    Style describes the visual appearance (colors and SGR text attributes) of a
    VT cell.

func (s Style) Effective() (fg, bg Color)
    Effective returns the rendered foreground and background colors, swapping
    them when Reverse is active.

func (s Style) SGR() string
    SGR returns the escape sequence that sets this style, resetting previous
    attributes first.

func (s Style) String() string

type VT struct {
	Cols, Rows int
	// CursorVisible reflects the last ?25 mode.
	CursorVisible bool
	// Frames holds a screen snapshot for every completed ?2026 frame.
	Frames [][]string
	// CellFrames holds a cell grid snapshot for every completed ?2026 frame.
	CellFrames [][][]Cell

	// Has unexported fields.
}
    VT is a minimal terminal emulator. It is not safe for concurrent use.

func NewVT(cols, rows int) *VT
    NewVT returns a blank VT of the given size with auto-wrap enabled.

func (v *VT) ANSI() string
    ANSI serializes the visible screen cells to ANSI SGR escape sequences and
    text. Trailing blanks on each row and trailing blank rows on the screen are
    trimmed. Each row is terminated by a newline.

func (v *VT) AltScreen() bool
    AltScreen reports whether DEC mode 1049 is active.

func (v *VT) Cell(x, y int) Cell
    Cell returns the cell at (x, y), or a zero Cell if out of bounds.

func (v *VT) Cells() [][]Cell
    Cells returns a snapshot of the current cell grid.

func (v *VT) Cursor() (x, y int)
    Cursor returns the zero-based cursor position.

func (v *VT) FrameCells() [][][]Cell
    FrameCells returns a copy of the cell snapshots taken at each ?2026 frame
    end.

func (v *VT) Pen() Style
    Pen returns the current SGR pen style.

func (v *VT) Resize(cols, rows int)
    Resize changes the grid size, keeping the top-left content, like a terminal
    that does not reflow.

func (v *VT) Screen() []string
    Screen returns the visible rows with trailing blanks trimmed.

func (v *VT) Text() string
    Text returns Screen joined by newlines.

func (v *VT) Write(p []byte) (int, error)
    Write feeds terminal output into the VT.
